description: This file defines the DefaultTypeManifestProvider class responsible for configuring a set of well-known types and allowed types in the Orleans serialization system. It implements post-configuration for TypeManifestOptions and sets up mappings for various system and Orleans-specific types.

classes.name: DefaultTypeManifestProvider
classes.description: Provides default type mappings and configuration for type manifest options in Orleans serialization

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Clears existing type manifest providers for fresh configuration

methods.name: ConfigureInner
methods.description: Initializes well-known type IDs with their corresponding .NET types and sets allowed types
